title: Bun thumbnail service
context: Generates thumbnails by running ImageMagick via Bun.spawn. Width must be a number from 16 to 1024. convert must be killed if it runs longer than 10 seconds. Temp files under /tmp/thumbs must be removed after every request, on success and on failure.
code: async function runConvert(src: string, dest: string, width: number) {
const proc = Bun.spawn(["convert", src, "-resize", `${width}x`, dest], { stdout: "ignore", stderr: "pipe" });
if (req.method !== "POST" || url.pathname !== "/thumb") return new Response("not found", { status: 404 });
if (width < 16 || width > 1024) return new Response("bad width", { status: 400 });
if (!FORMATS.has(format)) return new Response("bad format", { status: 400 });
const { code, stderr } = await runConvert(src, dest, width);

expected.why: setTimeout takes milliseconds, so convert is killed after 10 ms instead of 10 s
NaN (missing or non-numeric w) fails both comparisons, so an invalid width reaches convert
returns without deleting the src temp file (and any partial dest), leaking temp files on every failure
